name_input: M/S FUJITEC INDIA PVT LTD; FUJITEC INDIA PRIVATE LTD.; FUJITEC INDIA PVT. LTD.; FUJITEC INDIA PVT LTD; FUJITEC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
state_registered: Maharashtra (Mumbai head office per company website; manufacturing plant at Mahindra World City, Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu)
note: Entity existence confirmed only indirectly: the company's own website (fujitecindia.com/about-us) states 'Established in 2004 in Mumbai, Fujitec India Pvt Limited is a fully owned subsidiary of Fujitec Co., Ltd, Japan', and the contact page lists 'Fujitec India Pvt Ltd, 903-A, 9th Floor, Hiranandani Lightbridge, Saki Vihar Rd, Chandivali, Powai, Mumbai - 400072' as Mumbai head office plus a factory at Plot No. P-52, Mahindra World City, Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu 603004. The site also publishes an investor-relations page with CSR reports and a '22nd AGM Notice', consistent with a private limited company incorporated around 2004. Role assessed as manufacturer_trader: own manufacturing facility (since 2010) plus marketing/installation/service of imported Fujitec equipment and 100% acquisition of Express Lifts Ltd. NOT VERIFIED / NOT PUBLIC in this session: exact CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, exact date of incorporation, MCA status (active/struck off) and audited revenue for FY25/FY26. Registry aggregators (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com) returned HTTP 403, and the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable while Bing/Google returned irrelevant results, so no registry record could be read. No revenue figures are stated because no audited accounts or MCA filing was accessible - null, not estimated. No rejection grounds found (no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy), but MCA status remains unconfirmed and should be re-checked against the MCA master data. Note on input: declared HS 842810 (lifts/skip hoists) matches the company's actual product line (elevators, escalators, autowalks), so no HS correction is needed; the claimed industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) is inconsistent with the actual business (vertical transportation equipment) and should be corrected in the database.
